value.rationale: The source highlights the gap between (G)+(K) and Kripke representability as a central representation issue. Showing that the gap already occurs in the paper's finite-model class and at the minimum possible world cardinality is a motivated structural boundary: it rules out finiteness of W and G as a route to recovering Kripke representability. The limitation to unrestricted closure maps is explicit and mathematically informative rather than cosmetic.
